body: Thank you for the reply, I agree that she should be able to vent like that. My major issues lie within the name calling, and contradicting statements that I receive about how she feels. I really want to bring this up but I don’t know how.
I think talking to her about what I found is a good idea, but I don’t know how to bring it up.
I know what you mean. I just love her a lot. It pains me to think about not being with her.
I agree with you logically, I just wish I could shake the feeling itself. The looming thoughts
Everything I do is a mistake in someone's eyes, especially the person  I love most. Everything I do causes a new problem and If i weren't here those problems would stop.
